clips.title: The story
paras: Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to sell Deepmoss Spider Eggs to Booty Bay. Spider egg omelettes have become a craze there, and he sends travelers into the Stonetalon Mountains to gather fresh clutches for the overseas trade.

Booty Bay’s wealthy patrons and eccentric pirates have taken to spider egg omelettes, driving demand for rare ingredients across the Great Sea. Ratchet merchant Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to make a fortune by supplying the southern port. The Eastern Kingdoms have no supply of these spiders, so Mebok looks to Kalimdor’s wilderness for the eggs.

Deepmoss spider eggs lie in the Stonetalon Mountains, where the Venture Company has cut timber. You can find clutches beneath the trees still standing at Windshear Crag, or farther into the web covered depths of Sishir Canyon. Gathering them means facing venomous bites and thick infestations. Even seasoned scavengers may find the swarms hard to stomach.

Fresh eggs must cross the sea before they spoil or hatch. Mebok works with Ratchet’s Wharfmaster Dizzywig to book freight on goblin merchant ships bound for the docks of Stranglethorn Vale. Once the eggs are packed into crates, Mebok earns a tidy profit from the high seas trade in fine food.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay! The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.
In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider. Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!
In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.
In Sishir Canyon... Well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get the eggs, friend? I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay. I can already taste the profits!
Here is your cut, friend. I couldn't have made this deal without you.
